title: SOME/IP: Fix dissector using unregistered hfs (fixup abd6e92b)
description:
Update all dynamic hfs together, so that we don't call `proto_deregister_all_fields_with_prefix` more than once.

Fix #20556 (see comment there for details).

notes.body:
Even though I cannot reproduce, the change makes sense in general. If you update only one UAT, the data of the others are deregistered. The problem is not so much the way we deregister them but that we do not update all UATs at once (which originally we were doing).

I would however propose a change: if we call all `deregister_dynamic_hf_data` at once, why not refactor this and move 
`proto_deregister_all_fields_with_prefix(proto_someip, SOMEIP_NAME_PREFIX);` out? That could be a bit more efficient.

The same way I did `deregister_user_data` in `packet-signal-pdu.c`
